name: Eleazer
overview: The name Eleazer appears in Scripture associated with several distinct individuals who served God faithfully in different capacities. One Eleazer, the son of Abinadab, was sanctified to guard the ark of the LORD during its long stay in Kirjath-Jearim, symbolizing devoted stewardship of God's presence among His people. Another Eleazer was a Merarite Levite, highlighting the Levitical lineage and service. Additionally, Eleazer, son of Dodo, was one of King David's mighty warriors who demonstrated extraordinary courage and strength in battle, with the LORD granting victory through him. These instances collectively reveal Eleazer as a name linked to faithful service, whether in worship, warfare, or priestly duty, underscoring God’s provision of devoted men for His purposes throughout Israel’s history.
